destinations.name: Chefchaouen
destinations.tagline: The Blue Pearl of the Rif mountains
destinations.description: Every wall, step and doorway in Chefchaouen's medina is washed in shades of blue. Wander quiet alleys, browse leather and weaving workshops, drink fresh orange juice in the squares and hike up to the Spanish Mosque for sunset.

destinations.name: Marrakech
destinations.tagline: Souks, riads and the edge of the Atlas
destinations.description: Lose yourself in the medina, sip mint tea on a rooftop and head out to the Atlas Mountains and the Agafay desert.

destinations.name: Lisbon
destinations.tagline: Hilltop views, trams and pastéis de nata
destinations.description: Seven hills, tiled facades, fado in Alfama and day trips to Sintra and the Atlantic coast.

destinations.name: Kyoto
destinations.description: Thousands of shrines, the Arashiyama bamboo grove and the geisha district of Gion.

destinations.name: Istanbul
destinations.description: Hagia Sophia, the Grand Bazaar and sunset ferries across the Bosphorus.

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.description: From Ubud's jungle to Uluwatu's cliffs, Bali mixes culture, wellness and beaches.

destinations.name: Paris
destinations.description: The Louvre, Montmartre and long lunches: Paris rewards slow wandering.

tours.title: Chefchaouen Day Trip from Fes
tours.meetingPoint: Pickup from your riad or hotel in Fes
tours.excerpt: Spend a full day in Morocco's blue city, with a local guide and free time to explore.
tours.description: Drive through the Rif mountains to Chefchaouen, the blue-washed town that is one of Morocco's most photographed places. A local guide walks you through the medina's lanes and squares before you get free time for lunch, photos and the craft shops.
highlights: Guided walk through the blue medina
Free time for lunch and shopping

itinerary.title: Pickup in Fes
itinerary.details: Leave around 7:30 am and drive through olive groves and the Rif foothills.

itinerary.title: Guided medina walk
itinerary.details: Two hours through the blue alleys, Outa el Hammam square and the kasbah.

itinerary.title: Free time
itinerary.details: Lunch, fresh orange juice and time in the leather and weaving shops.

itinerary.title: Ras El Ma
itinerary.details: See the mountain spring where locals still wash wool.

itinerary.title: Return to Fes
itinerary.details: Back at your hotel around 8 pm.

reviews.author: Meriem T.
reviews.title: Like walking through a painting
reviews.content: Every corner was more beautiful than the last. Our guide knew the best photo spots.

reviews.author: James O.
reviews.title: Long day, totally worth it
reviews.content: The drive is long but Chefchaouen is magical. Great driver too.

reviews.author: Inès R.
reviews.title: Wish we had more time
reviews.content: Lovely tour. I'd happily have stayed overnight.

tours.title: Chefchaouen Medina & Artisans Walking Tour
tours.excerpt: Hidden blue lanes, weavers, leather workers and the best viewpoint over the town.
tours.description: A small-group walk with a Chefchaouen-born guide. Find the quiet blue lanes away from the crowds, meet weavers and leather workers in their workshops, and finish with mint tea and a view over the rooftops.
highlights: Quiet lanes away from the crowds

itinerary.title: Bab el Ain
itinerary.details: Meet your guide at the main gate of the medina.

itinerary.title: Blue lanes
itinerary.details: The most photogenic alleys and doorways, with time for photos.

itinerary.title: Artisan workshops
itinerary.details: Weavers, leather workers and basket makers at work.

itinerary.title: Outa el Hammam
itinerary.details: The main square and the red-walled kasbah.

itinerary.title: Tea with a view
itinerary.details: Mint tea on a rooftop terrace overlooking the town.

reviews.author: Lucía P.
reviews.title: Best way to see Chefchaouen
reviews.content: Our guide grew up here and took us to places we'd never have found.

reviews.author: Karim H.
reviews.title: Loved the artisans
reviews.content: Watching the weavers was the highlight. No pressure to buy.

tours.title: Agafay Desert Sunset Camel Ride & Dinner
tours.meetingPoint: Pickup from your riad or hotel in Marrakech
tours.excerpt: Ride camels across the stone desert at golden hour, then dine under the stars with live Gnawa music.
tours.description: Leave the city behind for the Agafay, a rocky desert just 45 minutes from Marrakech. Ride a camel through the dunes at sunset, then sit down to a three-course Moroccan dinner in a Berber camp while Gnawa musicians play by the fire.

itinerary.title: Hotel pickup
itinerary.details: Air-conditioned minivan from Marrakech, around 3:30 pm.

itinerary.title: Camel ride
itinerary.details: One hour across the Agafay at sunset with a camel handler.

itinerary.title: Tea at the camp
itinerary.details: Mint tea and Moroccan pastries as the sky changes colour.

itinerary.title: Dinner and music
itinerary.details: Salads, chicken tagine and dessert, with Gnawa music by the fire.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.details: Back at your hotel around 9:30 pm.

notIncluded: Drinks other than water and tea

reviews.author: Sara K.
reviews.title: Magical evening
reviews.content: The sunset was unreal and the guide was great with our kids. Dinner was generous.

reviews.author: Tom B.
reviews.title: Worth every dirham
reviews.content: Well organised, on-time pickup and a beautiful camp.

reviews.author: Lina M.
reviews.title: Lovely but busy
reviews.content: Beautiful setting, the camp was a bit crowded on a Saturday.

tours.title: Atlas Mountains & Three Valleys Day Trip
tours.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Marrakech
tours.excerpt: Waterfalls, Berber villages and lunch with a mountain view.
tours.description: Drive into the High Atlas through the Ourika, Asni and Imlil valleys. Stop at an argan cooperative, hike to the Setti Fatma waterfalls with a mountain guide and share lunch with a Berber family.
highlights: Waterfall hike with a local guide

itinerary.title: Pickup
itinerary.details: Leave Marrakech around 8:30 am.

itinerary.title: Argan cooperative
itinerary.details: See how argan oil is made by a women's cooperative.

itinerary.title: Setti Fatma waterfalls
itinerary.details: A 1.5-hour guided hike to the first waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Lunch
itinerary.details: Tagine lunch in a family home overlooking the valley.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.details: Back in Marrakech around 5:30 pm.

reviews.author: Marco R.
reviews.title: Great views
reviews.content: Long day in the car but the hike made it worth it.

reviews.author: Aya B.
reviews.title: Loved the guide
reviews.content: Our mountain guide was patient and funny. The waterfalls were beautiful.

tours.title: Marrakech to Merzouga 3-Day Sahara Tour
tours.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Marrakech
tours.excerpt: Cross the Atlas, visit Aït Benhaddou and sleep in a desert camp in the Erg Chebbi dunes.
tours.description: Three days from Marrakech to the Sahara and back. Cross the Tizi n'Tichka pass, explore the kasbah of Aït Benhaddou and the Dadès Gorges, ride camels into the Erg Chebbi dunes and spend a night in a desert camp.
highlights: Night in a Sahara desert camp

itinerary.title: Day 1: Atlas and Aït Benhaddou
itinerary.details: Cross the Tizi n'Tichka pass and visit Aït Benhaddou. Night in the Dadès Valley.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Gorges and dunes
itinerary.details: Walk the Todra Gorge, then ride camels to the desert camp at sunset.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Return
itinerary.details: Sunrise over the dunes, then the long drive back to Marrakech.

reviews.author: Hannah P.
reviews.title: Trip of a lifetime
reviews.content: The night in the desert camp was the highlight of our whole year.

reviews.author: Youssef A.
reviews.title: Lots of driving
reviews.content: Amazing scenery but be ready for long days in the van.

reviews.author: Claire D.
reviews.title: So well organised
reviews.content: Every detail was handled. The driver was excellent.

tours.title: Sintra & Cascais Full-Day Tour
tours.excerpt: Pena Palace, the westernmost point of Europe and the seaside town of Cascais.
tours.description: Skip the train queues with a small-group van tour to Sintra's fairy-tale Pena Palace, the cliffs of Cabo da Roca and the seaside town of Cascais, with free time for lunch.

itinerary.title: Pena Palace
itinerary.details: Guided visit of the palace and gardens.

itinerary.title: Sintra old town
itinerary.details: Free time to try a travesseiro pastry.

itinerary.title: Cabo da Roca
itinerary.details: The westernmost point of mainland Europe.

itinerary.title: Cascais
itinerary.details: Lunch and a walk by the beach.

reviews.author: Emily W.
reviews.title: Fairytale day
reviews.content: Our guide knew every shortcut at Pena. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: David L.
reviews.title: Good value
reviews.content: A lot packed into one day, well paced.

tours.title: Lisbon Food & Wine Walking Tour
tours.meetingPoint: Praça do Comércio, by the arch
tours.excerpt: Ten tastings in family-run spots, from bifanas to ginjinha and pastéis de nata.
tours.description: Eat your way through Baixa and Alfama with a local foodie. Taste cured meats and cheeses, a bifana pork sandwich, grilled sardines, green wine and the famous pastel de nata.

itinerary.title: Praça do Comércio
itinerary.details: Meet your guide and start with ginjinha cherry liqueur.

itinerary.title: Baixa
itinerary.details: Cheese, cured meats and a bifana sandwich.

itinerary.title: Alfama
itinerary.details: Grilled sardines and green wine in a tasca.

itinerary.title: Dessert
itinerary.details: Finish with a warm pastel de nata.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.title: Best tour in Lisbon
reviews.content: We came hungry and left stuffed. The guide was a delight.

tours.title: Fushimi Inari & Gion Walking Tour
tours.excerpt: Walk the thousand torii gates early, then explore Gion with a local guide.
tours.description: Start before the crowds at Fushimi Inari, then take the train to Gion for tea houses, temples and hidden lanes, finishing with a matcha tasting.

itinerary.title: Fushimi Inari
itinerary.details: Walk the torii gate tunnels up the mountain.

itinerary.title: Train to Gion
itinerary.details: A short local train ride.

itinerary.title: Gion
itinerary.details: Hanamikoji Street, Yasaka Shrine and back lanes.

itinerary.title: Matcha tasting
itinerary.details: Whisked matcha and a wagashi sweet.

reviews.author: Ken T.
reviews.title: Perfect intro to Kyoto
reviews.content: Our guide's stories brought the city alive.

reviews.author: Anna F.
reviews.title: Beat the crowds
reviews.content: Starting at 7am was the best decision.

reviews.author: Luis G.
reviews.title: Lots of walking
reviews.content: Bring good shoes! Great tour overall.

tours.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Temples
tours.excerpt: The bamboo forest, Tenryū-ji's Zen garden and the river views of Arashiyama.
tours.description: A morning walk through western Kyoto: the famous bamboo grove, the UNESCO-listed Tenryū-ji temple garden and the Togetsukyō bridge.

itinerary.title: Bamboo grove
itinerary.details: Walk the grove before the tour buses arrive.

itinerary.title: Tenryū-ji
itinerary.details: Visit the Zen garden with your guide.

itinerary.title: Togetsukyō bridge
itinerary.details: Views of the river and mountains.

reviews.author: Grace H.
reviews.title: Peaceful morning
reviews.content: The garden was breathtaking and our guide was very knowledgeable.

tours.title: Bosphorus Sunset Cruise
tours.meetingPoint: Eminönü pier, next to the Galata Bridge
tours.excerpt: Sail between Europe and Asia as the sun sets over the palaces and mosques.
tours.description: An evening cruise past Dolmabahçe Palace, the Rumeli Fortress and the Bosphorus Bridge, with Turkish tea and snacks on board.

itinerary.title: Boarding
itinerary.details: Board at Eminönü pier.

itinerary.title: European shore
itinerary.details: Dolmabahçe Palace and Ortaköy Mosque.

itinerary.title: Rumeli Fortress
itinerary.details: Turn back below the Bosphorus Bridge.

itinerary.title: Asian shore
itinerary.details: Return along the Asian side at sunset.

reviews.author: Omar N.
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.content: Relaxed and scenic, a little crowded on the top deck.

reviews.author: Julia Z.
reviews.title: Must do

tours.title: Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque Guided Tour

tours.excerpt: Explore Istanbul's two most famous landmarks with an expert historian.
tours.description: A small-group walk through Sultanahmet covering Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and the Hippodrome, with an art historian as your guide.

itinerary.title: Hagia Sophia

reviews.author: Ben C.
reviews.title: Fascinating

tours.excerpt: Tegallalang terraces, Tegenungan waterfall and the Sacred Monkey Forest.
